notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players, we have completed an update maintenance for the online server on August 30, 2024. The details of the update are as follows:

Content Additions

Fully completed Chapter 1's storyline
Fully completed Chapter 1's chibi animations
Reworked maps and gameplay for Chapters 1-5
Reworked some side quests and gameplay in Chapter 1
Bug Fixes and Adjustments

Fixed the layering issue with lifting the small stove
Corrected the display layer for damage fonts
Fixed the progress bar value display issue in the card system
Corrected the layering display error in side quest 1's map
Fixed the rock obstruction issue in 1-4
Added non-passable walls for bullets in maps
Changed event trigger conditions to after the monster death animation plays
Added reward preview function for treasure chests in various systems
Adjusted the main interface
Added functionality to jump to sub-function pages
Removed unit death deletions
After the update, simply log back into the game to start enjoying the new Chapter 1. We hope you like it.

notes.title: Saint Goddess August 24 Update Notice
notes.content:
[b]Saint Goddess August 24 Update Notice

This week, we've addressed numerous in-game bugs and have begun working on content updates and adjustments. The planned updates for this weekend, August 24, are as follows:

System Adjustments
[/b]
Adjusted all character animations, particularly the basic and skill attack frames for the starting character Hephaestus. Added additional effects; now you can experience a change in attack rhythm and certain skills will now have knockback or immobilization effects in their final hits.
Modified some characters' skill damage coefficients; skill 1 damage has been slightly increased.
Adjusted the difficulty curve of early-stage monsters, making them easier to defeat.
Revamped the Goddess interface to better showcase the artwork of different Goddesses.
The Goddess upgrade system is now available, allowing Goddess growth. You can now obtain Goddess experience items in the Chapters and Adventure systems.
Revised the announcement interface to display multiple announcements.
Adjusted the prologue OP storyline display.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Attack warnings should now properly disappear when enemies die.
Fixed an issue with daily rewards from the monthly card. Monthly card rewards will now be sent via mail.
Corrected the scrolling speed issue in the announcement interface.
Fixed display layering issues with artifact effects.
Resolved priority errors in hit effects; hit effects will now display correctly when monsters perform actions.
Corrected the placement of certain puzzle mechanisms to reduce instances of being stuck.
[b]Content Updates[/b]
Added a chibi version of the character Aria and corresponding animations.
Added chibi versions and some animations for the protagonist.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107180/2adf3e285dd2d23699a14165e2efa35164825020.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107180/7a66babdb5f8895b4dc3114428088a0295227383.gif[/img]
[b]Converted all prologue CGs and some Chapter 1 CGs to dynamic CGs.[/b]
Added HCG animations to the prologue, making them more consistent with the storyline.
[b]Introduced Athena’s 2nd stage HCG animation in the prologue.[/b]
Added chibi performances involving Aria and the protagonist in parts of Chapter 1.
Added chibi performance of Aria in bondage and CG of clothes being torn.
Added chibi performance scenes involving Hephaestus fragments and the protagonist.
Added and revised a significant amount of storyline text.
[b]Introduced new beginner guides.[/b]
Added Chinese Voices; the prologue and Chapter 1 are fully completed, with Chapter 2 partially done.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107180/52c57659d8fd4fc5871f803d6a51f8f69d5ad9bc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update Plan
notes.content:
[b]Update Plan
Expected Update Date: August 16[/b]

Album Feature Update: After the update, players will be able to see their progress and the total number of unlocked CGs at any time.
Implementation of Chinese and English Voice Acting for All Chapter Stories.
Addition of 9 HCGs in Level Stories.
Implementation of Chibi Character Cutscenes for Chapter 1 Map.
Implementation of BGM for All Game Chapters.
Supplementary Interface Sound Effects and Battle Sound Effects.
Adjustment of Monster Attack Desire, Monster Wave, and Configuration.
Adjustment of Character Affection Levels and Story Trigger Conditions.
Adjustment of the Attack Frequency of the Character Hephaestus and Skill Release Layer Details.

[b]Next Update Preview[/b]
Addition of Affection-Level HCGs.
Voice Adjustments.
Addition of Japanese Version.
New Team Dungeon Feature in PVE and Unlockable Multi-P Plot.
New Competitive Gameplay in PVP and Addition of NTR Storyline.
Dear players, please stay tuned! We’re not just a reskin of existing games, nor are we one of those pay-to-win games currently on the market. Of course, there are some microtransactions, but we won’t follow the old turn-based model where a single card costs over 4,000 RMB and doesn’t even unlock any CG. In our game, HCGs are plentiful! We’re confident about that, so come and check us out! Other features are in continuous development, and we welcome players to actively discuss and provide feedback.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107180/8f28559992e61d351d147ad24a9f9bbc6351206b.png[/img]
